# Miscellaneous › Story Complication

> This oracle will introduce narrative turns, troubles, and revelations. It can be used as an alternative to the Pay the Price table when you encounter a negative outcome at a crucial moment. In particular, you might use this table after rolling matched 10s on the challenge dice.
>
> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:starforged/misc/story_complication` · 1d100

- [4] Crucial equipment or device fails
- [3] Crucial equipment or device is sabotaged
- [3] Debt or promise comes due
- [4] Enemy reveals unexpected powers, abilities, or influence
- [3] Enemy reveals their true agenda or nature
- [3] Enemy unexpectedly benefits from your actions
- [3] Key location is made inaccessible
- [3] Key location is threatened or made unsafe
- [3] Natural disaster is imminent
- [4] Needed item or resource is unavailable
- [3] Object of a quest is not what you assumed
- [3] Old enemy resurfaces
- [3] Simultaneous problems force a hard choice
- [3] Someone important betrays your trust
- [3] Someone important is threatened or endangered
- [3] Someone important reveals their problematic secret or history
- [3] Something important goes missing
- [3] Technology or device is shown to have unexpected effects
- [4] Time pressure suddenly increases
- [4] Trap is sprung
- [3] True agenda of a connection or patron is revealed
- [4] Trusted information is shown to be false
- [4] Two seemingly unrelated problems are shown to be connected
- [4] Undermined by self-doubt or vulnerabilities
- [4] Unexpected enemies appear
- [4] Urgent message distracts you from your quest
- [4] You are tracked or followed
- [3] You were diverted from the true crisis
